title: Build a Local Second Brain for an Agent
pain_point: Useful links and project knowledge disappear across chats and agent sessions.
story: Install sdtk-brain, initialize or adopt a local vault, ingest bounded repository sources, compile safely, inspect the graph, search, and ask through local LM Studio.
product_proof: Run the real sdtk-brain install and initialization workflow.
Ingest bounded local source records and compile with the owner-approved apply receipt.
Open the real graph, inspect a source file, search the vault, and use SDTK-WIKI Ask with local LM Studio only.
source_boundaries: Use only the approved open-seo, EpicStaff, and page-agent source receipts.
Ask must use local LM Studio only and show grounded citations.

capture_contract.instruction: Capture the real sdtk-brain install, initialize, ingest, compile, and graph/search workflow. Capture SDTK-WIKI Ask only through local LM Studio with grounded citations; do not use a remote model runtime.
